name: Open spots
summary: A plan with a few open spots: requests come in with mutual friends and a note, the host accepts or declines, and spots fill.
useWhen: a plan with a fixed number of places that friends of friends can ask to join
'we have 3 spots on the hike', 'anyone can ask, Maya decides', 'open it up'
dontUseWhen: everyone in the chat is invited and you need a headcount (use squad-lock)

params.title: string
params.requests: [{name, meta, mutuals: names, note}] from outside the chat
